title: Seasonal Poster Continuity
description: Four reference-linked beverage posters establishing a coherent limited-time launch language.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the poster-safe composition, ingredient halo, color-block system, and vessel styling. Images 02-04 preserve that launch framework while rotating seasonal flavor cues and mood.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-launch-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
